records.source_rule: A 5 Pull skips the card immediately right of the 5 when that card is already clued or already gotten.
records.learning_objective: Select the next eligible pulled slot instead of redundantly getting an already-gotten card.
records.critical_variable: Cathy slot 2 is already clued/gotten while slot 3 is the next eligible card.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Pulling slot 2 again contradicts the explicit skip rule.
records.mutation: Make slot 2 untouched and the Pull gets slot 2 instead.
records.noise: Bob's irrelevant exact card was removed; the historical blue clue is represented as knowledge rather than a second current arrow.
records.timeline: pass: only Alice's current 5 clue is rendered as an action

records.source_rule: In Low Score Phase an otherwise-illegal number-5 Stall two-or-more-away from chop becomes a 5 Pull and takes precedence over Finesse/Bluff.
records.learning_objective: Prefer the 5 Pull over the apparent red-4 Finesse.
records.critical_variable: The adjacent card is playable and another normal Play Clue makes the 5 Stall illegal.
records.blind_answer: Cathy blind-plays slot 2 as the 5-Pulled card.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: A Finesse interpretation incorrectly treats the rank-5 clue as a direct Play Clue in Low Score Phase.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob could blind-play as a Finesse; that is the rejected line.
records.mutation: Make the adjacent card two-or-more-away and the move becomes 5 Number Ejection instead.
records.noise: Bob's hidden hand is masked because its exact identity is not part of the proof.

records.source_rule: An otherwise-illegal Early-Game 5 Stall on a 5 one-away-from-chop is an Early 5's Chop Move.
records.learning_objective: Apply the one-away-from-chop branch instead of calling the clue a Stall.
records.critical_variable: The 5 is exactly one-away from chop and another useful clue is available.
records.blind_answer: Chop Move the card to the right of the 5.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: An ordinary early 5 Stall is illegal while another useful action exists.
records.mutation: Move the 5 two-or-more-away from chop and the 5-Pull branch becomes relevant.
records.noise: The other playable card exists only to prove the Stall was illegal.

records.source_rule: A follow-up Play Clue to a currently unplayable card promises the 5-Pulled connector and collapses the Delayed Play alternatives.
records.learning_objective: Use the later red-3 clue to identify the pulled card as red 2.
records.critical_variable: Bob gives a Play Clue to unplayable red 3 while Cathy's pulled card could be red 2 or blue 2.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Keeping blue 2 in the superposition ignores the promise created by the new red-3 Play Clue.
records.mutation: Replace the red-3 Play Clue with blue 3 and the promise switches to blue 2.
records.noise: Cathy's hidden pulled identity is masked in Question and appears only as owner knowledge in Solution.
records.timeline: pass: historical 5/1 clues are not rendered as current actions

records.source_rule: All number-5 clues in Low Score Phase are never interpreted as direct Play Clues.
records.learning_objective: Apply the five-suit score threshold at score 9.
records.critical_variable: Score 9 is below the five-suit threshold of 10.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Calling rank 5 a direct Play Clue contradicts the Low Score rule.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Alice can use a color clue instead.
records.mutation: Raise the score to 10 and the direct rank-5 Play-Clue prohibition ends.
records.noise: Stack values exist only to establish score and playability.

records.source_rule: A 5 Pull is treated as Delayed Play Clue/potential Prompt and may connect through existing touched cards.
records.learning_objective: Wait for an existing red 1 instead of treating the pulled card like a normal Finesse.
records.critical_variable: A known red 1 has not played and the pulled card may be red 2.
records.blind_answer: Cathy may wait; she need not blind-play the pulled slot immediately.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Immediate play wrongly applies ordinary Finesse timing to a Delayed Play Clue.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Cathy can wait for the known connector.
records.mutation: Remove the existing red 1 and make the pulled card immediately playable; immediate play becomes natural.
records.noise: Historical red knowledge is shown without a second clue arrow; Cathy's hidden card is represented as a possibility.
records.timeline: pass: current 5 Pull plus historical red-card knowledge

records.source_rule: A 5 Pull Finesse always connects the pulled card to the blind-play; 5 Pull Bluff is illegal.
records.learning_objective: Reject an unrelated blind-play as justification for the pulled continuation.
records.critical_variable: Bob's blind-play is unrelated to the actual pulled card.
records.blind_answer: No; there is no 5 Pull Bluff.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Allowing the continuation would invent a convention explicitly disallowed by source.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Cathy can refrain from treating the blind-play as a Pull continuation.
records.mutation: Make Bob's blind-play connect and the line can be a 5 Pull Finesse.
records.noise: The post-play state removes the historical 5-clue arrow and Cathy's hidden identity.
records.timeline: pass: green 1 is already on the stack

records.source_rule: If the only ignored action is a 2 Save on chop, 5 Stall has priority over 5 Pull and Visible Rule yields Elimination Notes.
records.learning_objective: Prefer the special 5-Stall/2-Save interaction and infer a hidden red 2 in Bob's hand.
records.critical_variable: The only apparent alternative action is the chop red-2 Save.
records.blind_answer: Treat it as 5 Stall, write red-2 Elimination Notes, and do not repeat the 2 Save.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: 5 Pull would ignore the explicit special priority for the sole 2-Save alternative.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob can wrongly give the 2 Save himself; Visible Rule rejects that action.
records.mutation: Add another ordinary Play Clue and the special sole-2-Save priority no longer applies.
records.noise: Bob's physical red 2 is hidden in Question and represented only by Elimination Notes in Solution.

records.source_rule: Any Finesse performed while a player remains 5 Pulled is a Certain Finesse; responsive Certain Discard applies to the 5-Pulled card.
records.learning_objective: Attach Certain semantics to the pending pulled card.
records.critical_variable: Cathy remains 5 Pulled when she gives the Finesse.
records.blind_answer: Classify it as Certain Finesse; a Certain Discard refers to the pulled card.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Treating the Finesse as ordinary ignores the explicit 5-Pulled certainty rule.
records.mutation: Resolve the pulled card first and the later Finesse is no longer automatically Certain for this reason.
records.noise: Cathy's historical 5 clue and hidden pulled identity are not drawn as current or objective knowledge.
records.timeline: pass: only Cathy's current Finesse clue is an action

records.source_rule: An Ejected Chop-Moved card is skipped at Finesse Position when the called identity contradicts stored distance-from-playability information.
records.learning_objective: Use historical distance information to skip the old Ejected card.
records.critical_variable: The Ejected card was recorded two-or-more-away while red 2 was already one-away.
records.blind_answer: Skip the Chop-Moved card and play the next Finesse Position.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Playing the old card as red 2 contradicts the earlier distance note.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Cathy can play the current Finesse Position; the stored note rules it out.
records.mutation: If the called identity had also been two-or-more-away at Ejection time, the skip proof disappears.
records.noise: Exact hidden identities are removed; the old Ejection is carried by cm/distance knowledge only.
records.timeline: pass: later Finesse decision with historical Ejection knowledge

records.source_rule: If the adjacent card is two-or-more-away-from-playable, an otherwise-illegal Low-Score rank-5 Stall signals 5 Number Ejection and globally marks that card Chop Moved/two-or-more-away.
records.learning_objective: Choose Second Finesse Position and preserve the distance note after Ejection.
records.critical_variable: Cathy slot 2 is useful but two-or-more-away-from-playable.
records.blind_answer: Play Second Finesse Position; mark Cathy slot 2 Chop Moved and two-or-more-away.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: 5 Pull and 5 Pull Finesse are excluded by the adjacent card's distance.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob could use ordinary Finesse Position; that does not encode Ejection.
records.mutation: Make the adjacent card one-away and the move becomes a 5 Pull Finesse instead.
records.noise: Bob's hidden card identity is masked; Cathy's visible hand is required to establish distance.
records.timeline: pass: Question is trigger state; Solution is post-Ejection knowledge state

records.source_rule: A 5 Pull Finesse may be Clandestine; the pulled player waits when a playable card existed behind the first blind-play at clue time.
records.learning_objective: Wait after the first blind-play instead of prematurely resolving the pulled card.
records.critical_variable: Cathy saw a playable green 1 behind Bob's red 1 at clue time.
records.blind_answer: Take an unrelated action and wait for Bob's possible second blind-play.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Immediate play ignores the allowed Clandestine component visible from Bob's earlier hand order.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Cathy can immediately play the pulled card; that is the rejected alternative.
records.mutation: Remove the playable card behind Bob's first blind-play and the Clandestine reason to wait disappears.
records.noise: The diagram is post-red-1 and masks Cathy's own pulled identity while preserving Bob's visible remaining green 1.
records.timeline: pass: red 1 is already on the stack and the historical 5 clue is gone

records.source_rule: If the adjacent card is trash, an otherwise-illegal rank-5 Stall signals 5 Number Discharge; the next player uses Third Finesse Position and the adjacent card becomes globally known trash.
records.learning_objective: Differentiate the trash branch from Pull and Ejection and record global trash knowledge.
records.critical_variable: All 1s are played and Cathy's adjacent red 1 is trash.
records.blind_answer: Play Third Finesse Position; mark the adjacent card globally known trash.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Pull/Ejection branches require playable/useful distance states, not trash.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob can use First or Second Finesse Position; both signal the wrong branch.
records.mutation: Make the adjacent card two-or-more-away useful and the signal becomes 5 Number Ejection.
records.noise: Bob's hidden Discharge card is masked in Question and the Solution records only the globally useful result.
records.timeline: pass: Solution advances the blue stack after Bob's Discharge
